description: Sends the person's request to up to 3 licensed contractors near them who use Luma (the contractor app DouxProcess Inc. builds), Luma Pro members first, and returns the other matches with their own contact details. Call it once without consent to get consent_text and the disclosure, show both to the person, and call again with consent=true only if they agree. Never include card numbers, ID numbers or passwords.

address.description: Optional: the job address, only if the person gave it for this request.

category.description: A category id from list_categories, e.g. roofer.

consent.description: True only if the person read and agreed to consent_text.

details.description: What they need, in their words. No card numbers, ID numbers or passwords.

phone.description: A phone number the businesses can reply to.

where.description: A city and state ('Pasadena, CA') or a 5-digit ZIP. Never the person's own street address.

name: request_quotes
title: Get quotes from contractors nearby
